entities.name: Uriah Aswark
entities.description: Hunchbacked mana-controller, captain of the Grand Master of the Arena's fighters in Estark, who betrayed House Oor-tael.

entities.name: Oor-tael
entities.description: House betrayed on the Night of Fire.

entities.name: Zarel Ewine
entities.description: Grand Master who received information from Uriah.

entities.name: Night of Fire
entities.description: Destruction of the House of Oor-tael.

events.summary: Uriah betrays Oor-tael by feeding information to Zarel Ewine and unbarring the gate on the Night of Fire.
events.quote: unbarring the house's gate on the Night of Fire

events.summary: Uriah is rewarded by becoming captain of the Grand Master's fighters.
events.quote: He was rewarded by becoming the captain of the Grand Master's fighters.

events.summary: During the battle in the Great Plaza Uriah kills Tulan.
When Garth returns to fight Zarel, Uriah stabs the Grand Master in the back before being stabbed in the heart.
events.quote: Uriah stabbed the Grand Master in the back before being stabbed in the heart
